methods.label: Modèles et outils, fixtures contrôlées
methods.scope: Isolated current production model/tool tests, including explicit synthetic documentary, actor, storage and source fixtures; not native playthroughs. Evidence composes an archived interrupted phase (verified completed child processes only; original outer exit unobserved) and an explicitly recorded continuation phase; no completed suite is rerun or counted twice.

methods.label: Contrats hérités, géométries et réseau contrôlés
Vue FPS native
methods.scope:
Native foreground presentation pilot on unchanged production HTML.

Diagnostic navigation selects authored Aubagne (not a surveyed Marseille view),
places the camera at an existing collision-free road point, grants twelve ordinary
weapons for a presentation matrix and ammunition for their real reload checks. Active
simulation is stepped with the inherited diagnostic v020Tick; UI inputs, Canvas,
WebGL scene, collisions, firing, reload and browser storage remain production.
No network, renderer, input handler or localStorage is replaced.

methods.label: Retours de combat FPS natifs
methods.scope:
Combat feedback on exact production HTML and an existing authored hostile.

Readonly geometry/collision/LOS scouts and inherited camera/freeze diagnostics
prepare an Aubagne encounter, not a surveyed view or a continuous playthrough.
Ordinary starter pistol, enemy identities/health, ammunition and browser storage
are not granted or replaced. Mouse/keyboard fire and reload use production input.
v028NativeDamage invokes the real incoming-damage chain for the received-HP
display; it does not demonstrate an enemy attack. Simulation ticks and camera
placement are explicit diagnostic assistance. No randomness/network/HTML/storage
mocking; no private game variables are injected.
Scenes are rendered before transient feedback is emitted. Screenshots do not
redraw the slow 3D scene after an event; DOM visibility and real elapsed time are
recorded on both sides of each screenshot without extending feedback lifetimes.

methods.label: HUD natif, formats et commandes
methods.scope:
Native HUD layouts and controls on exact production HTML.

Authored Aubagne is selected by the existing diagnostic navigation API. Camera
placement/freeze and render pause are declared assistance. Input uses real DOM
controls, keyboard and Playwright pointer events; coarse pointer is emulated,
not a physical touchscreen certification. No HTML/storage/network mocking.
Temporary document observers count bubbling activation keys without intercepting
them or altering production handlers or state.
The existing v030Set diagnostic prepares an equipped powered suit to exercise
its real HUD and gauntlets; this is not an in-game acquisition proof.

methods.label: DOM avec API Gamepad simulée
methods.scope: Actual game + Chromium DOM, keyboard and localStorage; Gamepad API simulated and one explicit synthetic touch PointerEvent, no physical device validation. Existing diagnostics select authored Aubagne and collision/LOS-checked camera positions for LT aim and dispenser modal navigation; no dispenser stock/resources or weapons granted.

methods.label: Surfaces MNS natives, quatre sites
methods.scope:
Native HTTP inspection of real IGN MNS landmark surfaces, never a fixture.

One real browser context visits the Major, Notre-Dame de la Garde, the Vieille
Charite chapel and the Pharo site through
diagnostic geographic navigation. Source loading, mesh publication, collision,
LOS and save/Continue are production functions; cameras/freeze/time selection
are declared assistance. Elevated captures are labelled inspections and are
not evidence of unassisted walking or a complete architectural survey.

methods.label: Intérieurs, portes, services et dépôts natifs
methods.scope:
Assisted native HTTP pilot for two actual source-based interior programmes.

No browser starts without --run and coordinated frozen SHA values. Source usage
and footprints come from real installed IGN chunks; partitions, portals and all
furniture remain explicitly invented. Sector selection, measured collision-free
camera placement, render/simulation freeze, v020Approach and stepped production
physics use the same public diagnostic APIs as architecture_native_browser.py.
E-key entries, visible exit controls and cold Continue are native browser actions.
No synthetic terrain, actor, plan, save, HTML or HTTP response is injected.

methods.label: Dossiers et contre-dons natifs des factions
methods.scope:
Assisted native HTTP pilot of Communes/Gilets relay decisions on real geography.

One native context serves unmodified production bytes and real installed sources.
The current NPCs are approached at measured, collision-free points; normal E,
visible dialogue and Pip-Boy actions collect two exact relay commitments per
story, pay finite inventory supplies, publish Canal 13 replies and save/Continue.
Declared sector selection, camera placement, freeze and payment supplies are
assistance. No source geometry, actor, proof, outcome or storage is fabricated.

methods.label: Distributeurs Nuka-Cola natifs
methods.scope:
Native finite Nuka-Cola cabinet loop on exact production HTML.

Existing diagnostic navigation and frozen collision/LOS-checked cameras select
authored Aubagne/Marseille and an actual installed Huveaune relay. Payment
capsules and repair materials are prepared explicitly, never bottles, cabinet
state, merchant stock, actors, source geometry or save contents. E, visible DOM
buttons, keyboard focus and the real Continue button perform the game actions.
Portrait is an emulated viewport, not a hardware touchscreen certification.
No HTML, network, storage or production function replacement is used.

methods.label: Relief nord natif et anciens lots revisités
methods.scope:
Assisted native pilot of the two real northern Marseille terrain windows.

Production HTML and HTTP, installed source files, actual terrain reads and
rendered triangles are used. Diagnostic sector selection, render/simulation
freeze and measured collision-free camera placement are declared assistance.
No HTML, responses, terrain, actors or storage are injected or substituted.

methodCaveat: Methods overlap; sums are not equivalent playthroughs. Geographic placements, freezes, resource/rig preparation and simulated controller inputs are explicitly declared in each report. Raw metadata cancellations and external probe failures remain in their reports.
limitations: Full Marseille facade/interior 1:1 fidelity remains uncertified.
MNS measures observed upper surfaces, not architectural roof semantics or room plans.
Northern and southern terrain windows use nearest-resampled requested 1m nodes; the central 0.50m native lattice remains separate.
First-person meshes are original stylized family models, with partial hand cropping in some frames.
Physical mobile/gamepad hardware and exhaustive human playthroughs are not certified.
Pharo identification remains contextual; the Charite ground image is obstructed and elevated cameras are diagnostic.
A transient powered-suit notification can overlap assistance/tracking in narrow touch landscape; primary vital and ammunition controls remain separate.

changes.reason: Only the legacy adapter expected old PWA cache12. Release cache13 correctly refreshes the changed HTML. Updating the adapter replaces the current-cache fixture token while retaining all9 assertions, old-cache removal, other-app preservation and offline503 contracts.
